steps.name: Bishop
steps.text: Mixed-breeds... You mixed-breeds!

steps.name: Bishop
steps.text: Herald! What's the meaning of this?! Why are they still alive? What of theirs is worth sparing?!

steps.name: Bishop
steps.text: You must have realized they were nothing like you when first they slaughtered our bloodkin!

steps.name: Bishop
steps.text: You are a holy being, and they are mere filth!

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: *Spit*...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Very flexible, eh?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: We hacked away at your kind with cold weapons so as to not expose you to our technology. That way, you will never become something we can't deal with.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: But I guess I overestimated. You don't seem very sensitive at all... Can't even adjust to this much?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Looks like you just can't adapt to blades forged by Ægir technology. Am I right?

steps.name: Bishop
steps.text: Herald, she is insulting you!

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Bishop, oh, bishop... Can't you tell? Heh. Yes, I am confident I can kill you, and I could have done so right from the start.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: (Low roar)

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Ugh... (Cough)

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Brother, why won't you accept them?

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: They are my sisters, and so they are your sisters too.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: I can rouse you, rouse Ishar-mla, and, of course... Gla-dia too.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Just because your brothers swam for the shallow seas, you no longer recognize them as your brothers. You haven't looked back even once...

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: But our tribe cares.

steps.name: Bishop
steps.text: No... This is nonsense...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: So you believe every single word in that good book you're holding? Let me remind you, Bishop, but you, too, are spreading heresy in full view of the Iberians.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: It doesn't matter to me one bit what this thing tells me, but you are from the Church of the Deep. Perhaps you should be taking notes?

steps.name: Bishop
steps.text: Kill them... Kill them! Herald, do it! Their crimes are grave and unforgivable! They spout blasphemy against you and the sea!

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: If that is your wish... then I shall do it.

steps.name: Bishop
steps.text: It doesn't matter to you at all, does it? It doesn't matter if I ask this of you. You said so yourself! You will kill them!

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Yes, It doesn't matter to me.

steps.name: Bishop
steps.text: Then kill the... wandering singer first. Kill the one in the red dress!

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Trash. If I tell you to kill the person behind you, the bishop who's dressed like a strand of kelp, will you do it?

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Because he is my kin, and so are you. He calls out to me, and so do you.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Ah, humans.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Ægir are vile and hideous, aren't they? Admit it, Bishop.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: We are all foolish Ægir, and we like to apply what we think to lowlife beasts. You don't understand it at all.

steps.name: Bishop
steps.text: You mixed-blood!

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Well, if all you want is to protect us—Why not refuse?

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Refuse?

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: How do I... refuse?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Enough. Looks like you are indeed a lowlife. That's about as deep as you can swim.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: But listen up, Trash. I won't ask you to kill the weakling behind you.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: You are prey. Who would beg prey to do something?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: You want to hurt her? You will listen to his suggestion and kill Skadi, my hunter? You don't need that answer anymore, do you?

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: I have other ways, even with her dead. As long as there's a way, it doesn't matter to me.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: But you told me... to refuse...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Way too soon... *cough*...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: (Coughs up blood)

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: *Spit*. Whatever. If you have your heart set on killing her—You must first go through me.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Now, Gla-dia.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Whether you get to live and whether your flesh will continue to function... This is for you to decide.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: And let us decide that by hunting each other.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Each other... Each other. Yes. We will prey on each other. You will prey on me, and I will prey on you.
